appCreator: After a harness sync or a module add that brings in a new agent (such as the deep reviewer), the report and the push gate now say what the thread runs instead when its session does not offer that agent yet, so the sync finishes in the same thread.

After a harness sync or a pack add, the push is no longer stopped to ask for a code review and a QA run of harness files: files that are exactly what the harness lock records are skipped, and the size of the sync no longer makes the change count as risky. The app's own code in the same change is still reviewed and tested as before, and so is a harness file edited by hand.
The preview of a harness sync now lists every file it would change, so the full list can go in the PR as the large-jump note asks. A real sync still cuts long lists.
